messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1151] Sample Data For RHadoop
parts:
Hi,
I am afraid there is nothing more than what's already in the examples themselves. The scripts in the test directory are self contained meaning that they generate their own data and are run as part of the automated test procedure, so you may want to look there. In the examples directory, maybe a misnomer, I put stuff that's interesting but  not completely finished, so that people can take a look. When I have time I complete them and move them to tests.


Antonio
